//==
// # IVector path interfaces
//
// The capability shared by everything that can hand back a vector outline.
// Implemented by the primitive 2D shapes, by glyph outlines, and by the
// results of dashing, offsetting, and boolean operations; the path types it
// produces live in `paths.types.plato`.

// Anything that can present itself as a vector path: primitive shapes, glyph
// outlines, dashed or offset results.
interface IPath
{
    ToPath(x: Self): Path2D;
}
